newsitem.title: CANADA: C-MAC won't boost Circo Craft bid.
newsitem.headline: C-MAC won't boost Circo Craft bid.

text.p: C-MAC Industries Inc said on Thursday that it decided not to increase its bid for Circo Craft Co.

C-MAC, whose offer of C$9.50 a share of all outstanding Circo Craft shares expires Friday, said it made the decision after the announcement by a unit of Hicks Muse Tate and Furst Inc on Thursday that it was offering C$11 a share for Circo Craft.
C-MAC said the competing bid and expenses which would have to be incurred by Circo Craft if C-MAC increased its consideration, were compelling factors in its decision not to increase its offer.
